features.name: area_per_room_norm
features.description: Calculates the average area per room and normalizes it by a typical value (30 sqm) to create a scale-invariant measure of spatial density.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-invariant measure of spatial density, helping KNN group properties with similar layouts regardless of absolute size.

features.name: z_score_area
features.description: Standardizes the area_sqm feature using the training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the area feature to zero mean and unit variance, preventing it from dominating distance calculations in KNN.

features.name: z_score_rooms
features.description: Standardizes the rooms feature using the training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the room count, ensuring it contributes proportionally to the overall distance metric.

features.name: z_score_location
features.description: Standardizes the location feature using the training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the location code, allowing it to be meaningfully combined with other standardized features in distance computations.

features.name: z_score_floor
features.description: Standardizes the floor feature using the training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the floor level, balancing its influence on neighborhood geometry against other property attributes.

features.name: euclidean_dist_to_centroid
features.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance from the property to the multivariate centroid of the training data based on standardized area, rooms, location, and floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the overall typicality of a property by measuring its Euclidean distance to the dataset's multivariate mean, useful for identifying outliers.

features.name: manhattan_dist_to_centroid
features.description: Calculates the Manhattan (L1) distance from the property to the multivariate centroid of the training data.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an alternative, robust measure of typicality using L1 distance, which is less sensitive to extreme values in individual dimensions.

features.name: prototype_dist_large_apartment
features.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance to an unsupervised generic prototype representing a large apartment (150 sqm, 4 rooms) in the standardized feature space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures similarity to a generic large apartment prototype, creating a continuous feature that improves clustering of spacious properties.

features.name: prototype_dist_small_studio
features.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance to an unsupervised generic prototype representing a small studio (30 sqm, 1 room) in the standardized feature space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures similarity to a generic small studio prototype, helping the model identify and group compact living spaces.

features.name: high_floor_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for properties located above the 10th floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a binary indicator for high-floor properties, introducing a categorical dimension that helps partition the feature space for KNN.

features.name: semantic_location_desirability
features.description: Assesses the desirability of the location code based on typical urban real estate patterns, assigning a score from 0.0 (least desirable) to 1.0 (most desirable).
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates raw location codes into a continuous desirability score, providing a semantically meaningful dimension for distance calculations.

features.name: semantic_property_type_cluster
features.description: Assigns a semantic cluster ID (1 to 5) representing the property type (e.g., studio, family apartment, penthouse) based on area, rooms, and floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Assigns a discrete cluster ID based on property characteristics, acting as a categorical grouping variable to refine neighborhood boundaries.
